mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing 62 degrees with overcast skies by the Verona Area High School under a first quarter moon.

Public Works has announced that chip seal road treatments begin September 23, which will affect traffic on Cross Country Road, East Verona Avenue, and Liberty Business Park. Additionally, the City Plan Commission will meet on October 5 to discuss various development projects and site plans.
We have a busy schedule today with the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival and live music at Bailey's Run, while tomorrow you can check out yoga at Insight Wellness.
On September 5, the Verona Police Department responded to reports of cheese slices found on windshields throughout the city, which was identified as a local attempt at a viral social media prank.
Culver's of Verona is closed for a scheduled remodel, but they will be ready to serve you when they open today at 10:00 AM.
